title: The singular fibre embeds in the linear kernel
statement: Let k be a field, Y smooth over k with structure morphism f, L invertible, and s_0,...,s_r generating L. Suppose the associated morphism Y -> P^r_k of [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections] is an immersion. Let Z and p:Z -> Y be the reduced singular scheme and its projection from [def-zl-bertini-universal-family]. For any affine open U smooth of relative dimension d over k and every z in U there is a surjective kappa(z)-linear map E:kappa(z)^(r+1) -> kappa(z) plus kappa(z)^d and a closed immersion of the scheme-theoretic fibre (p|_U)_z into Spec(Sym_{kappa(z)}((ker E)^dual)). Its composite with the coefficient map, defined on polynomial generators by coordinate functionals restricted to ker E and on k by the residue-field map of U -> Spec k, is the original coefficient projection of this fibre. Invertibility and fibres use [def-sc-invertible-module] and [def-pc-scheme-fibre].

proof.text: Apply the first-order fibre-equations theorem to obtain E, A, the affine fibre isomorphism e and the quotient H with its generator vanishing and coefficient compatibility.

Apply the symmetric-algebra kernel factorization to H to get a surjective G from the symmetric algebra of the kernel dual. Spec(G) is a closed immersion, and composing with e gives j. Check its coefficient composite on constants using G.commutes and on variables using the generator compatibility; Spec.map_comp then identifies it with the original coefficient projection.

lean.statement:
theorem bertini_singular_fibre_kernel
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (r : ℕ)
    (s : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)) → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hgen : Epi (L.freeHomEquiv.symm (fun i ↦
      (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L) (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i)))))
    [IsImmersion (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) f L
      (fun i ↦ (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L)
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i))) hgen)] (U : Y.Opens) (_hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (U.ι ≫ f)] (z : U) :
    ∃ E : (Fin (r + 1) → (U : Scheme).residueField z) →ₗ[
            (U : Scheme).residueField z]
            (U : Scheme).residueField z × (Fin d → (U : Scheme).residueField z),
          Function.Surjective E ∧
          ∃ j : (bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiber z ⟶
              Spec (CommRingCat.of (SymmetricAlgebra ((U : Scheme).residueField z)
                (Module.Dual ((U : Scheme).residueField z) E.ker))),
            IsClosedImmersion j ∧
            j ≫ bertiniLinearKernelCoefficientMap ((U.ι ≫ f).residueFieldAlgebraMap z) E =
              (bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiberι z ≫
                ((bertiniSingularToSource f L s) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫
                (bertiniSingularIdeal f L s).subschemeι ≫ bertiniUniversalProjection f L s
